_comment: Tracked creator metadata for catalog source discovery. Families come from each Model document's identity.family, which tools/check-model-families keeps to one lineage per slug.

creators.name: vLLM project
creators.focus: Official vLLM model recipes, including Decision 3.0 native structured decisions with text, image and video inputs.

creators.name: MiaAI-Lab
creators.focus: Spark cookbooks for SGLang, vLLM and TensorFold; DSpark and EXL3 builds; Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek, Ling.

creators.name: tonyd2wild
creators.focus: Multi-Spark (2 and 4) vLLM recipes for large MoE models: GLM, MiMo.

creators.name: r0b0tlab
creators.focus: vLLM on GB10/SM121: EXL3 kernels, DFlash2 speculative decoding, GLM and Nemotron.

creators.name: drowzeys (keyz)
creators.focus: Large multi-Spark vLLM builds with prebuilt images: GLM, MiMo, abliterated variants.

creators.name: NVIDIA playbooks
creators.focus: Official DGX Spark playbooks and NVIDIA model releases: Nemotron, NVFP4 checkpoints.

creators.name: eugr
creators.focus: spark-vllm-docker: vLLM container builds for dual DGX Spark; llama-benchy benchmarking.

creators.name: Reederey87
creators.focus: Production GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 kit for two Sparks: 1M-token context with DFlash2, hybrid prefix-cache fixes and fat-expert MoE kernels.

creators.name: sfxnz

creators.name: vcruz305
creators.focus: Single-Spark EXL3 recipes on a GB10-tuned exllamav3 fork with TabbyAPI or vLLM: Qwen3.8 Flash Next, GLM 5.3 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.

creators.name: 0xSero
creators.focus: SparkInfer builds and local-ai-recipe-kit; DeepSeek V4 Flash on one Spark.

creators.name: amarjeet
